title: Flight Hours by Aircraft Type and Rating
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:entry
| stats sum(hours) as hours, count as flights by aircraft_type
| sort - hours
description: Totals your logged flight hours by aircraft type, the record you need for ratings, insurance, and hire.
value: Accurate per-type totals matter for checkrides and renting aircraft, and are tedious to tally by hand.
implementation: Ingest logbook entries into `index=personal`; total hours and flights per aircraft type.
visualization: Bar chart of flight hours by aircraft type.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up your flying hours by aircraft type, the record you need for licences and hiring planes.
